name: Naruto Heroes
description: Three hidden villages from Naruto as playable towns: Konohagakure, Sunagakure and Kirigakure, with their shinobi, heroes, tailed-beast bosses and artifacts.
author: Anton Morozov

0.4.0: Sunagakure and Kirigakure towns: 28 creatures, 4 hero classes, 26 heroes, town screens from the artist
0.3.0: Hero and creature portraits from the generated art
Static battle sprites for the Konohagakure creatures
Kurama, the first tailed-beast boss, with rendered animation
0.2.0: Konohagakure town: 14 creatures, 2 hero classes, 25 heroes, borrowed original graphics

russian.name: Герои Наруто
russian.description: Три скрытые деревни из «Наруто» как играбельные города: Коноха, Суна и Кири — с их шиноби, героями, хвостатыми зверями-боссами и артефактами.
